Shaam ke 7 baj rahe the
Mirzapur ke mele mein
chaaron taraf bas bheed hi bheed thi
Isi bheed mein Gupta family bhi thi
jo bachchon ke saath mela ghoomne aayi thi
Aur unhi bachchon mein tha
8 saal ka Dhruv
Blue jacket pehne Dhruv
pichhle aadhe ghante se
balloon lene ki zid kar raha tha
Jab kisi ne uski baat nahi suni
to woh chupchaap balloon lene khud chala gaya
Kareeb 10 minute baad
gharwalon ko jab wo kahin nahi dikha
to unhe laga
kisi jhoole ya dukaan ke paas ruk gaya hoga
Sab alag-alag taraf dhoondhne lage
Par Dhruv nahi mila
Dhoondhte-dhoondhte Dhruv ke maa-baap
ek balloon bechne wale ke paas pahunche
Balloon wale ne turant kaha —
Dhruv ke pita ke is ek sawal ke
unhe 5 jawab mile
Aur jawab bhi aise the
ki sun kar dono ke pasine chhoot gaye
Par ye dar sirf Gupta family tak
rukne wala nahi tha
Mela Chowki ke Constable se lekar
Lucknow mein baithe DGP tak
Dhruv ki talaash
Police system ke har level ko hilane wali thi
Isliye ye sirf kidnapping ka case nahi hai
Balki ye wo seedhi hai jispar chadh kar
hum ek-ek karke dekhenge
ki uniform pe lage stars
aur badges ka matlab kya hota hai?
Police ki alag-alag ranks
actually mein karti kya hain
SHO, IO, CO
ye ranks hain ya kuch aur?
Aur ant mein hum is ek sawal ka jawab dhoondhenge
ki Police mein sabse powerful kaun hai
MIRZAPUR · UTTAR PRADESH
